name: Canal+ Telecom Guadeloupe data center, Moudong/Jarry
notes: RCI reported Canal+ Telecom inaugurated a data center on 2022-04-28 in Moudong, Jarry industrial zone, Baie-Mahault, serving enterprises and public authorities; Baie-Mahault/Jarry is in the Basse-Terre division. Capacity not disclosed.

name: DMA Informatique local Guadeloupe datacenter, Jarry
notes: DMA Informatique advertises Guadeloupe hosting from a local secured datacenter with redundant power and cooling, raised anti-seismic floor, and multi-operator fibre/copper feeds; company address is Jarry, Baie-Mahault. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Data Center Guadeloupe One / DataCenter ONE, Les Abymes
developer: Dauphin Telecom / Data Center Guadeloupe / HELIUM Technologies
notes: Dauphin Telecom Business and Dauphin Telecom Infrastructure describe Data Center Guadeloupe One/DataCenter ONE in Les Abymes, connected to the Jarry backbone and regional networks; HELIUM says it was built in 2017 with 50 m2 hosting space. Legal filings show active DATA CENTER GUADELOUPE entity at Parc d'Activite de la Providence, Les Abymes. Capacity in MW not disclosed.
